Story

Cameras initiate targeted work

Richtech Robotics announced on November 11 that it will demonstrate its Intelligent Cleaning System at ISSA Show North America on November 17–19. The system is designed to connect existing indoor CCTV cameras with DUST-E robots, identify areas needing cleaning and initiate targeted tasks automatically.

A shared operational dashboard

The dashboard combines robot locations, cleaning records, equipment status and maintenance or consumables alerts. The idea is to use facility observations alongside scheduled cleaning. Multiple robots will be exhibited, but the announcement does not establish that every capability is available on every model.

Demonstration evidence is still pending

The release provides no dirt-detection accuracy, supported-camera list, pricing or independently verified customer results. Facility managers should distinguish the described capability from demonstrated site performance. An ecosystem video is planned for the event; that clip is not linked in the announcement.
